subject: general
question: A person offers a 15% discount on his garments, and he offers a further discount of 10% on the reduced price to those customers who pay cash. What will a customer have to pay in cash for a jacket of Rs. 3,600?
solution:
**Given:**

A person offers a 15% discount on his garments, and he offers a further discount of 10% on the reduced price to those customers who pay cash

Price of jacket = Rs. 3,600

**Formula used:**

Successive discount = (A + B) - (AB/100)

SP = MP(1 - D%)
